title: Effective computation of Moore-Penrose inverses over fields of rational functions by specializations
summary: In this paper we consider matrices whose entries are rational functions of several parameters over a Moore-Penrose field, that is, a field with an involutory automorphism over which every matrix has Moore-Penrose inverse. We prove that over any such field the Penrose conditions can be solved with linear algebra alone, even though they form a polynomial system of degree two. We then bound the degrees of the numerator and of the denominator of the pseudoinverse in terms of the degree of the entries and of the rank, and not of the dimensions of the matrix.
